Bituma nyiri telefoni ashobora gufunga iyi ecran akoresheje dashboard ya NexGuard iyo telefoni yabuze.
Nubihagarika, nyiri telefoni ntazongera gushobora kuyifunga ari kure, kandi azabimenyeshwa.
Yerekana ko NexGuard isangiza nyirayo aho iyi telefoni iri.
Ubutumwa n\'inzogera byoherejwe biturutse kuri dashboard ya NexGuard.
NexGuard: iyi telefoni yatangajwe ko yabuze
Aho iri hasangizwa konti ya NexGuard ya nyirayo.
Iyi telefoni yabuze. Nyamuneka hamagara nyirayo.
Murakoze kudufasha. Nyirayo ashobora kubona aho iyi telefoni iri.

Akenshi: fungura Phone Master (cyangwa Settings > Battery) > App launch cyangwa Power saving, ushake NexGuard, wemere Auto-launch, Secondary launch na Run in background. Hanyuma ufunge NexGuard ku rutonde rwa porogaramu uheruka gukoresha.
Akenshi: Settings > Apps > NexGuard > Battery > Unrestricted. Urebe kandi ko NexGuard itari muri Sleeping apps.
Akenshi: Settings > Apps > NexGuard > fungura Autostart, hanyuma Battery saver > No restrictions.
Akenshi: Settings > Battery > App launch > NexGuard > Manage manually, hanyuma ufungure ibintu bitatu byose.
Akenshi: Settings > Battery > NexGuard > Allow background activity, hanyuma ufungure Auto-launch.
Akenshi: Settings > Apps > NexGuard > Battery > Unrestricted (cyangwa Don\'t optimise).
Iyi PIN irakenewe kugira ngo uhagarike uburinzi kuri iyi telefoni. Uwayibye ntashobora guhagarika NexGuard atayifite.

Twohereje kode y\'imibare 6 kuri SMS kuri %1$s.
Nyuma yo gutunganya, aho iyi telefoni iri hazasangizwa konti yawe ya NexGuard. Igihe cyose hasangizwa, hagaragara itangazo kuri telefoni.
Uruhushya ruke rutuma NexGuard ikomeza gukora iyo porogaramu ifunze cyangwa ecran ifunze.
NexGuard yerekana itangazo igihe irinda iyi telefoni, ikerekana n\'inzogera n\'ubutumwa uyoherereje.
NexGuard ifata aho iyi telefoni iri ikahohereza kuri konti yawe ya NexGuard, kugira ngo ushobore kuyibona niramuka ibuze. Hitamo \"Precise\".
Kugira ngo ukomeze kubona telefoni iyo NexGuard ifunze cyangwa ecran ifunze, hitamo \"Allow all the time\" kuri ecran ikurikira. Aho uri hasangizwa konti yawe gusa.
Utahisemo \"Allow all the time\", NexGuard ikora gusa iyo porogaramu ifunguye cyangwa itangazo ryayo rigaragara.
Telefoni nyinshi zihagarika porogaramu zikora inyuma kugira ngo zizigame umuriro. Reka NexGuard ikore nta kuyibuza. %1$s
Hitamo PIN uzi wenyine. Irakenewe kugira ngo uhagarike uburinzi kuri iyi telefoni.
